title: Lixir's One Little Block
description: Adds a block that drops random items when mined (and syncs properly)
body:
Adds a block that drops random items from any loaded mods when mined and syncs properly with the server and client.

Features:
- Block that adds random items when broken directly to your inventory
- Syncs properly with the server and client (no ghost blocks)
- Mines faster with any tool
- 1 tick delay when mining to regenerate
- Has cool particles


It can be given through /give @s lolb:random_item_block

Thanks to my good friends braildesimater873, foreman, and husbandry for the name
